# SafeOrStolen

SafeOrStolen helps buyers and sellers check secondhand-item identifiers and marketplace listings. It supports phones, vehicles, license plates, serial-numbered electronics and power tools, firearms, bicycles, and boats.

Sources: SafeOrStolen's own theft reports and public web results on every check. Bikes are also searched against a national stolen-bicycle registry. Guns are also searched against more than 220,000 police firearm theft and loss reports from 33 states and Washington, DC (filed 1973–2017) and live Ohio law-enforcement records. Arizona VINs and plates are also searched against Arizona, Alaska and Chicago police stolen-vehicle records. A paid phone blacklist check is available.

Also: VIN checks decode the vehicle and list open safety recalls. For title or registration questions, contact the state motor vehicle agency, and for title brands, get a vehicle history report. SafeOrStolen's Proof of Clean Purchase is a dated verification record, not a legal document, ownership proof, or guarantee.

Primary guide: https://safeorstolen.com/how-to-check-if-item-stolen
Vehicle guide: https://safeorstolen.com/how-to-check-if-car-stolen
Phone guide: https://safeorstolen.com/how-to-check-if-phone-stolen
Marketplace analyzer: https://safeorstolen.com/marketplace-url-checker
Verification: https://safeorstolen.com/verify

A free account includes two checks. Additional checks are $0.99 for 2 or $10 per month unlimited.
